name: Croagh Patrick Heritage Trail
description_md:
The Croagh Patrick Heritage Trail is a waymarked hiking route in IE. It covers a distance of 59.9 km and is signposted as CPHT.

This route is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is classified as hard due to the distance and 839 m of ascent. The trail involves 785 m of descent and requires about 17 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. It passes Aghagower Round Tower within 100 m.
